# spacelab-coverage

Access-window detection: sign-change bracketing and bracket-preserving root refinement.

Part of [spacelab](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab), astrodynamics in Rust organised around independent
verification: every published number is checked against a lineage that did not come
from the project. This crate is verified in [§3 Orbital mechanics & automatic differentiation](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab/blob/main/docs/verification.md#3--orbital-mechanics--automatic-differentiation) (12 rows).

- API documentation: <https://docs.rs/spacelab-coverage>
- Homepage: <https://spacedatalab.org>
